sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Find the Manila Room. Remaining inside it long enough will take you to the next level.

sections.heading: Controls
items: Esc: pause, or close the current menu

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Find the exit through the garage while avoiding hazards and entities.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Pick up the torch near the start if you do not already have it.
False puddles are dangerous if you step too close.
Hounds can be delayed by pointing the equipped torch at them.

sections.heading: Objective
sections.text: Move through the maintenance tunnels and find the documented exit.

sections.heading: Survival
items: Smilers linger on wall faces in dark areas. Do not get too close and do not shine the torch at them.
Deathmoths roam the tunnels and are attracted to active light sources.
Some low obstacles can be jumped over with Space.
